name: restful-booker-postman
description: Postman collection testing the Restful-Booker booking lifecycle (auth, create, update, verify, delete) with chained variables, schema checks and negative tests.

scripts.test:ci: newman run collections/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e environments/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --env-var username=$RB_USERNAME --env-var password=$RB_PASSWORD --reporters cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml
